name: United Way
summary: A US network of about 1,100 local United Ways, led by United Way Worldwide, that raises money mostly through workplace campaigns and spends it on grants to local social-service agencies, 211 helplines and its own programmes.

spending.source: https://www.forbes.com/companies/united-way-worldwide/?list=top-charities (Forbes financials panel, US United Way network, fiscal year to June 2025: charitable services $2.9B of $3.5B total expenses; rounded to $0.1B; Forbes warns results may be skewed by unconsolidated data)

lines.label: US network programmes (grants to local agencies, 211 helplines, free tax help, own programmes)
lines.source: https://www.forbes.com/companies/united-way-worldwide/?list=top-charities (charitable services $2.9B; no network-wide split by programme is published. United Way Worldwide, the national office alone, spent $57.8M on programmes in 2024: https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/131635294/202542519349301609/full)
